description: This Java class `MessageOnlyLogFilter` implements the `LogNode` interface, serving as a filter in a logging chain to only pass along log messages without additional metadata. It is used to simplify log outputs, especially for on-screen logs, by suppressing metadata and just forwarding messages.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that forwards only log messages, filtering out metadata.

methods.description: Constructor that takes the next LogNode in the chain to facilitate chaining.
